svg.title: Molecule of the day: Aspirin
svg.desc: A rotating 3D structure of Aspirin while a graph neural network predicts its lipophilicity (logD) as -1.51.
svg.text: MW 180.2 · cLogP 1.31 · TPSA 63.6 · HBD 1 · HBA 3 · RotB 2
3-layer message-passing GNN · 4,200 molecules · held-out RMSE 0.603 (R² 0.731) · descriptors from RDKit
